node.title: No cierre efectivo del mundo abierto
node.summary: A finite run can close its record while the semantic question remains open.

relations: A finite routing run can be valid within its declared frame without certifying all future operating conditions; open-world limits do not make every bounded VRP undecidable.
Comparación retrospectiva de alcance; el mini-paper de octubre de 2026 no describe una técnica usada en xSeil en 2016.
